Title: Fixing bash prompt colours
URL: https://shellfix.example/prompt-colours

Bash prompt colours
Colours in the prompt come from the PS1 variable. Add this line to ~/.bashrc:
export PS1='\[\e[32m\]\u@\h\[\e[0m\]$ '
